bm_caver.text: Bermuda is limestone on top of an extinct undersea volcano. The caves formed when rainwater ate the rock and the sea level was lower.
The Crystal Caves were found by two boys in 1907. The lake is saltwater, and so clear it looks like glass. Don't drop anything.
The stalactites grow about a centimetre every hundred years. Everything in here is older than every argument you've ever had.
